read_colmap_bin_array: read a Colmap binary array file and return a transposed numpy array with width, height, and channels
read_points3D_text: read a Colmap point3D.txt text file and return xyz coordinates, rgb values, and errors as numpy arrays
read_extrinsics_binary: read a Colmap images.bin binary file and return a dictionary of registered images with poses and point correspondences
read_intrinsics_binary: read a Colmap cameras.bin binary file and return a dictionary of cameras with intrinsics parameters
qvec2rotmat: convert a quaternion vector to a 3x3 rotation matrix
